description: The chart compares the distribution of human preferences for hypotheses with and without demonstrations across three datasets: Truthful Review, Funny Reddit, and Unhealthy Comments. Each dataset is represented by a pie chart with three slices, totaling nine slices across the three charts. The slices are labeled as "W/o Demos" (grey), "Hard to Tell" (blue), and "W/ Demos" (green), with percentage labels inside each slice. The proportions for Truthful Review are 43% (W/o Demos), 22.9% (Hard to Tell), and 34.1% (W/ Demos); for Funny Reddit, they are 41.5% (W/o Demos), 21.5% (Hard to Tell), and 37.1% (W/ Demos); and for Unhealthy Comments, they are 37.8% (W/o Demos), 27.4% (Hard to Tell), and 34.8% (W/ Demos). The charts do not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices are consistently ordered in the same way across the charts, with "W/o Demos" being the largest or second-largest slice, followed by "W/ Demos", and then "Hard to Tell".
